units.source_text: 我查閱了許多妻子被人姦汙這方面故事內容的書，但沒有一個女人像良子一樣遭受如此悲慘的侵犯。

en.t: I read many books containing stories about wives being violated by other men, but not one woman suffered an assault as miserable as Yoshiko's.

units.source_text: 她的侵犯根本不能成為故事。

en.t: Her violation could not become a story at all.

units.source_text: 在那個矮個子商人和良子之間，倘若有那麼一點近似於戀愛的情感，我的心情說不定反而會好受一點。

en.t: If there had been even the slightest feeling resembling love between that short merchant and Yoshiko, I might even have felt a little easier.

units.source_text: 然而，就是在夏日的某個夜晚，良子相信了那個商人，僅此這一點，

en.t: Yet on one summer night, Yoshiko trusted that merchant, and because of that alone,

units.source_text: 我也因此被人迎面砍傷了眉間，哭啞了嗓子，長出了白髮，

en.t: I too felt as if I had been split between the brows from the front; I cried myself hoarse and began to grow white hair,

units.source_text: 使得良子不得不一輩子在我面前畏畏縮縮。

en.t: and Yoshiko was forced to spend her whole life shrinking fearfully before me.
